selection: pooled development bonus-MSE; ties choose smaller tau
calibration: premium WACE = count-weighted absolute cell bias across price [8,10), >=10 x FWD,MID; use previous-GW price. Report all cells and total calibration separately.
exception: Apply exact preregistered P1 exception by judging improved bonus calibration and top-k when the primary 3-SE requirement fails; report every failed primary criterion explicitly. No exception for top-k guard failures.
exception_scope: B1 only: a combination must retain the ordinary primary requirements; no automatic extension of the P1 exception to B1+P2.
